payload.summary: Indexed the repo with CodeGraph 1.5.0 (49 files, 441 nodes, 1656 edges) and documented it in AGENTS.md outside the nahel orientation block: agents query codegraph explore/node/callers/impact/affected before grep, and run codegraph sync after edits. .codegraph/ is gitignored (machine-generated SQLite, rebuilt per machine with codegraph init .). MCP install left at Claude Code global only; the shell CLI is the vendor-neutral path for codex and other agents.
